question: Can Tolaria West's transmute find a card whose entire mana cost is X, such as a card costing {X}{X}?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: a card whose whole mana cost is X symbols, like {X}, {X}{X} or {X}{X}{X}, has mana value 0 while it is in your library, so transmute can find it.
expected.answer: Cards with mana cost {X}, {X}{X}, or {X}{X}{X} have mana value 0.

source.license: Reproduced from the official Wizards of the Coast card-ruling text distributed for use by Magic: The Gathering tools and reference sites; this project already commits and serves this exact rulings corpus in production (see committedDataPath) as its card-ruling retrieval source.
source.questionAuthorship: The question is this project's own natural-language phrasing of a scenario the cited card's official ruling directly answers; the answer is the ruling's text, verbatim.

whyHard: Players look at the printed cost instead of working out that X is zero when the card is not on the stack, and then overshoot by assuming any cost containing X is mana value 0, when {X}{R} is mana value 1.
